text: In 2021, 2.23% of the property (81.3 hectares out of 3,643.5 hectares) experienced tree-cover loss. The primary forest type affected was planted pine (68.1 hectares), with the remainder either outside mapped forest areas or smaller, unmapped patches. The data is corroborated by independent sources, including the European Commission’s JRC 2020 forest reference, which confirmed 98% of the loss area as forested in 2020. The analysis excluded smaller patches under 0.5 hectares (37.3 hectares), as they did not meet the minimum event threshold.
